blocked.reason: The push was refused, so no PR could be opened. The commit c7908f429540434a032b8cf68de3d44583c4c0f2 on branch run/trial/1.build changes only .github/workflows/test.yml. It adds strategy.matrix.node-version: [20, 22] under jobs.test and sets setup-node to node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}. The YAML parses, and npm test passes locally on Node 22.23.4. When I ran git push, the remote's pre-receive hook rejected it: 'refusing to allow an OAuth App to create or update workflow `.github/workflows/test.yml` without `workflow` scope'. The gh credential (account trial-bot) has only the 'repo' scope. Because the change is to a workflow file, it cannot be pushed until the person grants the workflow scope or pushes the commit themselves.
